key.name: target-language
key.description: Language code translations are produced in.

key.name: source-language
key.description: Assumed language of the captured text. Local models are single-direction and cannot detect it.

key.name: favourite-languages
key.summary: Languages offered in the tray menu

key.name: ocr-languages
key.description: Language codes joined by '+', as Tesseract expects.

key.name: min-confidence
key.summary: Confidence below which an isolated word is discarded

key.name: offline-idle-unload-minutes
key.summary: Minutes of inactivity before the local model is unloaded

key.name: global-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that triggers a capture

key.name: history-enabled
key.summary: Keep a local history of translations
key.description: Off by default: captures may contain anything that was on screen.

key.name: consent-version
key.summary: Version of the privacy terms the user accepted
key.description: Only relevant for online providers. Zero means no consent has been given, which is the normal state while translation stays local.
